action_items: 1. **Immediate Line Halt**: Immediately quarantine and halt the suspect station to prevent false DUT rejections.

2. **Audit Configuration Delta**: Review recent configuration version commits, audit station cable loss compensation, and inspect `cable_loss_compensation_table` entries against the golden calibration ledger.
3. **Reference Path Verification**: Inspect the physical reference path, RF jumper cables, and torque all SMA/3.5mm connectors to 8 in-lbs (0.9 N-m).
4. **Golden Re-characterization**: Re-run the golden reference standard across all sweeps. Verify measured insertion loss agrees with nominal reference values to within +/-0.30 dB.
5. **Configuration Baseline Restoration**: Restore the last verified baseline configuration table before releasing the station to production.

secondary_docs.title: MAN-801: Product Hardware Revision and Test Limit Matrix Synchronization
action_items: 1. **Verify Unit Hardware Revision**: Inspect physical serial number and QR barcode to establish true product revision status.
2. **Audit Limits Version**: Review `limits.csv` against current Engineering Change Notices (ECN).
3. **Align Test Limit Matrix**: Load corresponding limit set for the target product revision (e.g., activate `LIM_V2.0` for `REV_B`).
4. **Re-execute Sequence**: Re-run testing under matched limits to confirm compliant parametric performance.
secondary_docs.excerpt: - **Controlled Parametric Shift**: The target device exhibits deliberate engineering design differences (e.g., lower insertion loss nominal of $-1.40\text{ dB}$) that violate tighter legacy limits (e.g., upper limit $-2.00\text{ dB}$). - **Healthy Repeatability and Golden Runs**: Golden reference units pass with high precision; multi-station runs on the target DUT are completely repeatable. -...

secondary_docs.title: MAN-501: RF Fixture Interface, Launch Pin Wear, and Contact Repeatability
action_items: 1. **Fixture Cleanliness Inspection**: Inspect fixture RF launch pins and contact interfaces under 20x magnification for debris, bent tips, or flux contamination.
2. **Alcohol Swab & Decontamination**: Clean probe contacts using electronic-grade isopropyl alcohol (IPA) and lint-free micro-swabs.
3. **Repeatability Verification**: Perform a 5-cycle re-seat and reconnect repeatability test using a verification unit. Confirm sweep-to-sweep repeatability variance $\sigma < 0.05\text{ dB}$.
4. **Fixture Alignment & Clamping**: Adjust mechanical guides and verify clamping pressure conforms to production mechanical specifications before resuming testing.
secondary_docs.excerpt: - **High Intra-Run Repeatability Sigma**: Replicate sweeps without DUT movement demonstrate erratic variance ($\sigma > 0.30\text{ dB}$), especially above 4.0 GHz. - **Reconnect Delta Shift**: Disengaging, re-seating, and re-engaging the DUT into the fixture yields large discontinuous measurement shifts ($> 0.80\text{ dB}$). - **High Return Loss Degradation**: S11 return loss spikes toward 0 dB...
